paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Thursday, batted second and started at third base for Minnesota Twins against Los Angeles Angels. Minnesota Twins fell to Los Angeles Angels, 4-5.
Brooks Lee drove in 1 run with a sacrifice fly in the eighth to deep left field on a 0-1 80 mph sweeper from Tayler Saucedo.
Brooks Lee put his club in front in the 10th with a go-ahead single to right field on a 2-0 90 mph sinker from Blake Weiman, changing the score from 3-3 to 4-3.
title: Brooks Lee comes through late with a go-ahead hit
